result_summary.title: Active Directory Sync showing certificate warnings in ME Dev
result_summary.description: We are observing persistent certificate warning messages within the Active Directory Sync component in our Middle East development environment. The sync seems to continue, but the security alerts are concerning for our compliance checks. 7 users are seeing this warning. Please verify the certificate chain validity for the sync endpoints.
